title: Principal Application Software Engineer
description:
**Job Description**

* About the Company/Team

Oracle Health Data Intelligence (HDI) is a newly established organization within Oracle Health, created to revolutionize how healthcare and technology intersect. HDI is focused on building a next-generation platform to support modernized, automated healthcare through data-driven innovation and cloud-scale engineering. With the entrepreneurial spirit of a startup and the global impact of Oracle, the team is building the foundation for intelligent healthcare products that serve patients, providers, and partners worldwide.
  
  
HDI’s mission is to
**transform healthcare through intelligent data applications**
—enabling better decisions, operational efficiency, and clinical outcomes. This is a net-new line of business, providing a rare opportunity to shape its culture, engineering excellence, and technical direction from the ground up.
  
  

* Job Summary

As a
**Principal Software Engineer**
, you will design, build, and scale complex cloud-based applications and services that power Oracle Health Data Intelligence products. You’ll be responsible for defining system architecture, developing robust and secure applications, and mentoring junior engineers. This role demands a deep technical understanding, strong problem-solving abilities, and a passion for building impactful software that drives the healthcare industry forward.
  
  

* Qualifications & Skills

**Mandatory:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* 8+ years of hands-on experience in software development.
* Proficiency in Java and any Major java script framework for application development.
* Strong experience with Relational Databases (SQL, MySQL).
* Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs.
* Experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) or other cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Knowledge of microservices architecture, CI/CD pipelines, and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Solid understanding of software design principles, distributed systems, and cloud-based architectures.
* Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.

**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Application Software Development:**

* Drives feature development within an application.
* Provides global production support to cloud-based applications as needed for critical issues by applying a working knowledge of at least one specialty area.
* Troubleshoots and debugs routine and non-routine Oracle applications services and Oracle Cloud infrastructure, end-user application integrations, or acquisitions.
* Partners across QA and engineering teams to discuss changes impacting an application's functionality and ensures quality and consistency across specific applications.
* Considers designs of the existing software architecture when developing code for applications.
* Translates requirements and features into a structured, scalable, maintainable, and performant code plan for an application.
* Contributes to establishing the dependencies (e.g., API) associated with the functionality of an application.
* Discusses application requirements with the customer while considering scalability and reliability, and recommends build priorities within teams and defines build priorities within team.
* References and shares other sources of feedback (e.g., online forums, live site maintenance reports) to refine application requirements.
* Collaborates with Designers, Product Managers, Software Engineers, and stakeholders when evaluating and integrating customer specifications and business requirements.

**Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization:**

* Designs software solutions and analyzes and identifies requirements to achieve business and operational goals, sharing results with manager upon completion.
* Adheres to and improves execution of all phases of the software development lifecycle; provides guidance and coaching to engineers to drive improvements.
* Utilizes advanced knowledge to develop and guide new software features and enhancements leading design specifications, ensuring accessibility, and develops documents to clarify software design and code.
* Leads code reviews in multiple areas to help drive improvements.
* Conducts debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix complex software issues.
* Develops fixes for identified issues.
* Implements comprehensive software testing (e.g., functional and non-functional testing), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging, sharing work with manager and/or lead upon completion.
* Conducts performance profiling and optimization of coding, building scalable solutions, and anticipating and resolving potential outcomes.
* Troubleshoots and resolves complex issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration. Implements complex API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies.

**Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design:**

* Implements and contributes to developing software, systems, and services, ensuring review by manager and/or senior technical leaders upon completion. Recommends project or design scope.
* Provides technical guidance and coaching to less experienced developers in existing software architecture.
* Contributes to periodic reviews and ensures adherence to architectural standards.
* Collaborates with stakeholders and networks externally to ensure work aligns with software architecture.
* Implements complex performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design.
* Occasionally conducts technology research and evaluation for potential architectural changes that may have an impact on results for the team.

**Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support:**

* Collaborates with stakeholders to understand customer issues and align solutions.
* May provide advanced technical guidance and support to customers regarding customer-reported issues.
* Advocates for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback.
* Provides input to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication.
* Identifies and implements customer issue and/or defect handling and training processes.
* Investigates and troubleshoots complex and broad-reaching/scoped maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions (e.g., future enhancements).

**Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance:**

* Collaborates with the team and externally to follow development practices and coding standards, providing coaching to less experienced team members.
* Participates in peer review processes, provides technical leadership, and ensures code quality and adherence to broad acceptance criteria during development, independently.
* Demonstrates and shares advanced knowledge of industry best practices and applies them to software development processes.
* Implements complex secure coding practices to prevent security vulnerabilities.

**Development Operations - System Maintenance:**

* Performs periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e.g., for critical vulnerabilities), sharing results with manager upon completion.
* Drives improvements, ensures automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability.

**Core Responsibilities**
**Planning & Execution:**

* Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.

**Collaboration & Partnership:**

* Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.

**Problem Solving:**

* Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem-solving strategies.

**Continuous Learning:**

* Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.

**Performance and Development:**

* Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

title: Software Engineer II
description:
**Life at UiPath**
The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.
  
  
To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.
  
  
Could that be you?
  
  
**Your mission**
Agents and automations are only as good as the data they can reach.
**Data Fabric**
is UiPath’s unified data layer: it models and stores business data, federates data from external enterprise systems without copying it, and makes it available wherever it’s needed across UiPath.
  
  
We are looking for a Software Engineer II to build core parts of Data Fabric platform. Backend expertise is a must, and full stack experience is a plus. You will spend most of your time on services, APIs, and platform capabilities, and also contribute to the web experiences customers use.
  
  
At UiPath, we are tackling exciting challenges at the intersection of AI and intelligent agents. If you want to be part of it, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
**What You'll Do At UiPath**

* Passion for Building Scalable Solutions: Demonstrated ability to produce robust, well-tested, high-quality code while adhering to best practices in software development. Monitor what you ship in production, debug cross-service issues, and help resolve incidents.
* Ownership and customer focus: Own your features from design to production, with guidance on larger designs. Keep the customer experience at the center of what you build.
* Drive AI innovation: Build platform capabilities that let AI agents and automations discover and use business data through Data Fabric.
* Backend and distributed systems: Design, build, and optimize scalable, secure services and APIs for the large-scale, multi-tenant Data Fabric platform, with a focus on performance, reliability, and high availability.
* Contribute to the user experience: Build and improve web UI in Angular or React with TypeScript, and connect it to the backend services you build.
* Team Collaboration: Work well in agile teams, contribute towards team alignment, and foster a collaborative environment where ideas and knowledge are freely exchanged.
* Use AI tools well: Use AI tools and coding agents for development (for example, code generation, testing, debugging, and documentation), while keeping a high engineering quality bar.
* Effective Communication Skills: Clearly articulate technical ideas, design decisions, and solutions to diverse audiences in both written and verbal formats while driving consensus.

**What You'll Bring To The Team**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in Engineering or Computer Science, or equivalent experience.
* 3 to 5 years of software engineering experience building backend or full stack production services.
* Strong skills in a backend language such as C# (.NET) or Java, and a willingness to learn new ones.
* A builder's mindset and a bias for action: you take initiative, turn ideas into working software quickly, and stay comfortable with ambiguity.
* Curiosity about how AI is reshaping software development and the systems we build.
* Solid grasp of object-oriented programming, design patterns, data structures, algorithms, multithreading, asynchronous programming, and system design basics.
* Experience with relational databases such as SQL Server or PostgreSQL, including schema design and query performance.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
* Familiarity with CI/CD, agile development, and writing automated tests.
* Clear written and verbal communication, and comfort working with globally distributed teams.

Nice to have
  
  

* Experience with front-end development using TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, with React or Angular.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or other container technologies.
* Familiarity with GraphQL or data mesh architectures.
* Understanding of LLMs and the AI powered API automation.
* Familiarity with observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Azure Monitor.

Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.
  
  
Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. The application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or may close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.
  
  
We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes. Additionally, UiPath provides reasonable accommodations for candidates on request and respects applicants' privacy rights. To review these and other legal disclosures, visit our privacy policy.

description:
Job Title: Software Development Engineer - II
  
  
Department, Level: Content Commerce, P2
  
  
Location: Onsite, Bangalore
  
  
Work Type: Full time
  
  
Job Summary: As an SDE-II, you will design and build high-performance services that power mission-critical ad delivery, targeting, and measurement systems across JioStar's platform. You will operate at the intersection of scale, reliability, and real-time decisioning - supporting live sports, premium entertainment, and personalized experiences for millions of users. This is a high-ownership, high-impact role best suited for engineers passionate about building for scale and business impact.
  
  
About the Team: Content Commerce is a new and high-impact bet for JioHotstar. The team will build the technology that powers commerce experiences across JioHotstar’s content surfaces.The platform will bring together content understanding, product catalogues, contextual recommendations, interactive placements, transaction journeys, attribution, and partner integrations. It will support experiences ranging from products featured within entertainment content to merchandise, brand activations, and contextual commerce during live sports.
  
  
Reporting To: Engineering Manager
  
  
Key responsibilities:
  
  

* Build robust, secure, and scalable microservices to power JioStar applications
* Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code using best practices, conduct unit testing and participate in code reviews
* Ensure sub-second server response times and implement appropriate data stores - relational, document, key-value, object, or graph - as well as index stores and messaging systems
* Take ownership of running and maintaining cloud infrastructure
* Continuously evaluate relevant technologies and influence architecture and design discussions
* Collaborate with Product Managers and cross-functional teams to understand requirements and deploy high-quality software solutions that meet business objectives
* Guide and mentor junior engineers and interns on functional and domain areas

Skills and attributes for success:
  
  

* Proficiency in Java, Golang, or Python
* Experience building distributed domain-driven microservices
* Strong understanding of database and storage fundamentals
* Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred), messaging systems (Kafka), and CI/CD pipelines
* Experience working on large-scale production systems, with a strong focus on performance and reliability is a plus
* Ability to translate ambiguous product requirements into well-structured, scalable technical solutions

Preferred education and experience:
  
  

* Bachelors/Masters in Computer Science or a related field with 2-4 years of experience in backend development

  Direct experience establishing spec-driven AI development workflows in production teams.

JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.

  
  

**You must be located in and authorized to work in the country noted in the job description to be considered for this role.**

  
  

Please note: There is an expectation that our engineers participate in on-call shifts. You will be expected commit to being ready and able to respond during your assigned shift, so that alerts don't go unaddressed.

  
  

**Language:**

  

JumpCloud has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently.  Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

  
  

**Why JumpCloud?**

 

  

If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.  

  

 

  

One of JumpCloud's three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO

JumpCloud is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

description:
**We help the world run better**
At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.
  
  
**What You'll Bring**

* You have deep experience in distributed systems and scalable application design, with strong hands-on skills in LLMs, advanced RAG patterns, and agentic workflows.
* Experience building agentic workflows on SAP AI Core and integrating LLM-based features into CAP Java applications is expected.
* Proficiency in system design for scale, resiliency, and fault tolerance is required.
* Strong experience in performance optimization, cost management, and troubleshooting complex production systems is essential.
* A solid understanding of SRE principles, observability (logs, metrics, tracing), and incident management is expected — including Open Telemetry instrumentation and SAP Cloud Logging dashboards.
* Experience designing evaluation frameworks for AI systems, validating model behavior, and applying agentic engineering patterns is critical.
* You use Claude-style tools to generate code and ideas, but you read and challenge their output — you know when the AI is making the wrong call in both code and design.
* Familiarity with multi-tenant SaaS architecture on SAP BTP (MTX, service-manager, IAS/AMS) is a strong advantage.

**Four Values Matter At Every Level**

* Learning agility (non-negotiable, and the most important value) — you rapidly pick up new models, frameworks, SAP Technologies, ontologies, and industry processes. You enjoy updating your mental model as the landscape shifts, which it will, frequently.
* Bias for action — you move quickly from ambiguity to a working prototype and learn through execution.
* Critical thinking — you ask the right questions, so we stay focused on the objective instead of just managing the day.
* End-to-end ownership — you own the outcome from problem definition through build, deployment, and evaluation.

**What You'll Build**

* You'll independently design and architect scalable, AI-native application systems and components, including advanced RAG pipelines and multi-agent workflows.
* You'll design and build AI agents integrated into GHRA's revenue accounting domain — including formula explanation, disposition computation assistance, and production volume analysis — using SAP AI Core and Python as primary programming language, CAP in Java will be secondary programming language.
* You'll contribute to the design of ontology-grounded agents for the domain, encoding accounting rules, formula structures, and ownership relationships as structured knowledge that agents can reason over reliably, rather than relying on prompt-only approaches.
* Evaluation and benchmarking frameworks to measure AI system quality, reliability, and performance are things you'll build and own. This includes domain-specific test harnesses that validate LLM outputs against known good formula results and accounting rules — and the honest memo that explains why an idea shouldn't ship.
* You'll optimize latency, throughput, and cost efficiency across systems — including HANA Cloud query optimization and AI Core inference cost management.
* Observability and SRE practices, including monitoring, alerting, incident response, and root cause analysis, are areas you'll implement and improve — specifically enabling OTEL tracing across the CAP microservice fleet and building Cloud Logging dashboards for cross-service visibility.
* You'll partner with platform, data, and AI teams to design robust, production-ready solutions and improve system integration. System scalability, resilience, and maintainability are areas you'll continuously work to strengthen.

**Where you belong**
If you need stable, well-defined requirements before you can start, this role will be uncomfortable. If you'd rather supervise an AI than trust it blindly, and you want to be the technical bridge between a complex accounting domain and an AI platform, keep reading. You'll take end-to-end technical ownership of critical systems and contribute to engineering excellence across the team. You'll be the technical bridge between GHRA's domain logic (royalty, production volumes, ownership allocation) and the AI platform layer — translating accounting business rules into context that agents can reason over reliably. Mentoring less-experienced engineers, guiding design and code quality, and building strong technical capabilities within the team are all part of the role. Itron Resiliency Solutions is an innovative business unit within Itron focused on solving mission critical problems for utilities through software and AI. Resiliency Solutions offers unique, market leading solutions for front-line worker safety, storm response, excavation damage prevention, construction management, and many more. These software and AI solutions solve end-to-end challenges for the utilities that power our society and are used by the largest and most complex organizations in the world such as National Grid, Southern Company, and Exelon.
  
  
Itron Resiliency Solutions is a global, diverse team of builders and innovators who tackle previously impossible challenges for our customers. If you have a desire to challenge yourself, solve impactful problems, and work with a passionate and talented team, this is the place.
  
  
The Emergency Preparedness & Response (EP&R) team builds the systems that keep critical operations running when it matters most. When storms and severe weather threaten communities and infrastructure across the US, our platform enables customers to rapidly procure, mobilize, and manage the workforce needed to respond to and recover from storm damage — often under tight timelines and high-stakes conditions. We are looking for a Principal Engineer who is deeply hands-on, works backward from customer pain points and business needs, and measures success by impact rather than lines of code shipped. You will be the technical anchor of the team: a backend-heavy full-stack engineer who knows our systems inside and out, reasons rigorously about trade-offs, and raises the engineering bar for everyone around you while leading the team toward outcomes that genuinely matter.
  
  
**About The Role**
We're hiring a Software Engineer in Bengaluru to build and run production services. You'll own features end to end — from understanding the problem to shipping, monitoring and fixing what you built — with growing independence and support from senior engineers.
  
  
Our India engineering team is taking full ownership of core products and growing quickly, including a ground-up rebuild of a customer-critical service. You'll work closely with senior engineers, your Engineering Manager, Product and Customer Support.
  
  
What you'll own in your first year
  
  

* Own: Own features and services end to end with speed and quality — build, test, release, monitor, fix.
* Well-scoped problems, then bigger ones. Start with clearly defined work and grow into breaking down ambiguous problems yourself.
* Design. Write design notes for your features and get them reviewed; contribute to larger designs led by senior engineers.
* Quality. Write tests, add observability, and take part in on-call so issues are caught before customers see them.
* Customers. Understand who uses what you build, and learn from support issues what to fix next.
* Code reviews. Give and receive thoughtful reviews, and help onboard engineers who join after you.

What you must bring
  
  
These are the bar. We can't teach them on the job.
  
  

* Experience: 1–4 years building production software. We level on demonstrated scope, not years alone.
* You've shipped code that runs in production. Features or services you built, released and supported — not only coursework or prototypes.
* You are strong at problem solving. You can take an unfamiliar, feature-sized problem, reason through it, and land on a simple, correct solution.
* You work independently toward a clear goal. Given a clear goal, you figure out the steps, unblock yourself, and ask for help at the right moments.

We care how you engineer more than which language you did it in.
  
  
Technical background
  
  
You've built production software with a modern stack, such as:
  
  

* Cloud: hands-on with AWS — you've deployed and debugged services running on it.
* Languages: strong in at least one modern language such as Python, Java or JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Frameworks: modern service frameworks such as FastAPI, Node.js or equivalents.
* Databases: solid data modeling and query fundamentals — you can design a schema, use indexes well, and explain why a query is slow and how you'd fix it.
* Fundamentals: data structures, API design, and the basics of caching and concurrency.

Exact tools matter less than depth. Strong experience on an equivalent stack is welcome.
  
  
What sets great candidates apart
  
  

* Impact you can explain. You can say what changed because of something you built — for users, performance or reliability.
* One problem you went deep on. A bug, a performance issue or a design where you dug past the surface to understand why.
* Ownership beyond the ticket. You've fixed what you shipped when it broke, and improved it after release without being asked.
* Framework mindset: You notice repeated code and turn it into something reusable.
* Learning speed. You've picked up a new domain, codebase or technology quickly and delivered in it.
* Curiosity about the user. You've asked why a requirement exists, or suggested a simpler way to solve the user's problem.

What we look for in everyone we hire
  
  
Whatever the role, we hire for six things.
  
  

* Customer obsession. You care who uses what you build and whether it actually helped them.
* Impact over activity. You measure success by outcomes, not tickets closed or lines written.
* Honesty. You're specific about your own part in team work, raise problems early, and say what didn't work.
* Independence. You don't wait to be told every next step. You figure things out with little hand-holding. You will work with leaders who will partner with you in the journey.
* Passion. Not the word on a resume — the evidence: a side project, a technology you went deep on, something you built because you wanted to.
* Depth. At least one thing you've built or debugged that you can explain down to the internals and the tradeoffs.

Itron is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce and providing an authentic workplace experience for all employees. If you are excited about this role but your past experiences don't perfectly align with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. In the end, you may be just who we are looking for!
  
  
The successful candidate's starting wage will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills and experience.
  
  
Itron is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you require an accommodation to apply, please contact a recruiting representative at 1-800-635-5461 or email Accessibility@itron.com.
  
  
Itron is transforming how the world manages energy, water and city services. Our trusted intelligent infrastructure solutions help utilities and cities improve efficiency, build resilience and deliver safe, reliable and affordable service. With edge intelligence, we connect people, data insights and devices so communities can better manage the essential resources they rely on to live. Join us as we create a more resourceful world: www.itron.com

title: Principal Engineer – AI Security Developer
description:
**Overview**
**Connecting clients to markets – and talent to opportunity.**
With 5,400+ employees and over 80,000 institutional, commercial, and payments clients, we operate from more than 80 offices spread across six continents. As a Fortune 100, Nasdaq-listed provider, we connect clients to the global markets – focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world-class products and services to all types of investors.
  
  
Whether you want to forge a career connecting our retail clients to potential trading opportunities, or ingrain yourself in the world of institutional investing, StoneX Group is made up of four business segments that offer endless potential for progression and growth.
  
  
**Business Segment Overview**
**Corporate:**
Engage in a deep variety of business-critical activities that keep our company running efficiently. From strategic marketing and financial management to human resources and operational oversight, you’ll have the opportunity to optimize processes and implement game-changing policies.
  
  
**Position Purpose:**
At StoneX, defending a global financial services organization increasingly means building capabilities ourselves rather than waiting for the market to provide them. As a
**Principal Engineer – AI Security Developer**
, you’ll serve as the senior technical authority for how StoneX applies AI to cybersecurity, setting the technical vision, architecture, and engineering standards for our AI security platform while personally building the hardest and highest-leverage parts of it.
  
  
Your mission is to define how AI becomes a secure, scalable, and trusted capability across the security organization. You’ll establish the reference architecture for GenAI applications, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) platforms, advanced analytics, shared services, and the guardrails and engineering patterns that allow multiple teams to build consistently and safely.
  
  
**This is a senior individual contributor role with enterprise-wide influence, not a role removed from the technology.**
You’ll remain a hands-on engineer while shaping technical direction across multiple security and engineering teams. You’ll make the difficult architectural decisions, build shared platform capabilities, prototype new approaches , solve the hardest technical problems, and raise the engineering bar for how AI capabilities are designed and delivered across StoneX.
  
  
From
**Day 1**
, you’ll begin shaping the technical direction of StoneX’s AI security capabilities while getting hands-on with the platform and the problems our teams are trying to solve. You’ll work across security, engineering, infrastructure, data, risk, and other partners to identify where AI creates meaningful value, establish the architecture and standards teams can build upon, and help turn that direction into trusted production capabilities at scale.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Primary duties will include:**

* AI Security Strategy: Define and own the multi-year technical strategy and roadmap for AI-powered security capabilities, translating business and risk priorities into a sequenced engineering direction.
* Reference Architecture: Design and govern the target architecture for StoneX’s AI security platform, including LLM services and orchestration, agent frameworks, RAG and knowledge pipelines, evaluation infrastructure, data access patterns, and integrations across the security environment.
* Platform Engineering: Architect and build shared platform capabilities including secure LLM services, agent runtimes, tool and connector frameworks, retrieval services, prompt and model management, and observability that allow teams to deliver AI solutions quickly, consistently, and securely.
* Hands-On Engineering: Remain deeply technical by personally designing and building complex and critical components, prototyping new approaches , and helping teams solve difficult engineering problems across the full stack.
* Technical Decision-Making: Lead evaluation of models, frameworks, vendors, and open-source technologies and make recommendations based on security, performance, cost, maintainability, and long-term strategic value.
* Portfolio Prioritization: Partner with security leadership to identify , size, and prioritize high-impact AI opportunities across detection, response, vulnerability management, identity, cloud, application security, and other security domains while challenging work that does not demonstrate meaningful value.
* Secure Integration: Establish patterns for integrating AI services and agentic workflows with security technologies including source-code repositories, threat models, cloud platforms, SIEM, SOAR, IAM, CMDB, and vulnerability management systems while enforcing appropriate least privilege, auditability, and human oversight.
* Production Excellence: Establish expectations for reliability, scalability, latency, monitoring, operational readiness, and cost management across production AI workloads.
* AI Security & Assurance: Serve as a technical authority on securing AI systems against prompt injection, data leakage, model and supply-chain risk, agent tool misuse, adversarial manipulation, and other emerging threats.
* Evaluation & Quality: Establish how StoneX evaluates LLM and agent performance through benchmark datasets, automated evaluation pipelines, red teaming, regression testing, and measures of accuracy, hallucination, reliability, and analyst trust.
* Responsible AI: Partner with Risk, Compliance, Legal, Data Governance, and Architecture to ensure AI capabilities meet regulatory, model risk management, privacy, and data residency expectations.
* Engineering Standards: Set and champion standards for AI engineering, including architecture, code quality, design review, testing, CI/CD, documentation, and production readiness.
* Technical Leadership: Influence technical direction across security, infrastructure, data, and application engineering teams, building consensus and resolving complex cross-team technical challenges without relying on direct authority.
* Developing Engineers: Mentor senior and staff-level engineers, strengthen AI engineering capability across the security organization, and help shape technical hiring standards and career development.
* Executive Advisory: Serve as a trusted technical advisor to the CISO, security leadership, and executive stakeholders by clearly communicating technical strategy, trade-offs, risks, and measurable outcomes.
* Industry Leadership: Represent StoneX within the broader security and AI community through industry engagement, working groups, conferences, publications, or open-source contributions and bring relevant external thinking back into the organization.

**A typical week might include the following:**

* Spending at least four days in the office engaging directly with engineers, security teams, architects, and other stakeholders.
* Designing and building critical components of StoneX’s AI security platform, particularly where the technical complexity or organizational leverage is highest.
* Working with security leadership and engineering teams to identify and prioritize AI use cases based on measurable security value, feasibility, and strategic importance.
* Leading architecture and design reviews for AI capabilities that span teams, security domains, or enterprise technologies.
* Evaluating emerging models, agent frameworks, development approaches, vendors, and open-source technologies against StoneX’s security, performance, cost, and maintainability requirements.
* Prototyping new AI capabilities to validate difficult technical concepts before establishing reusable patterns that other engineers can build upon.
* Working with engineering teams to solve difficult integration, architecture, scalability, reliability, or security challenges.
* Reviewing production AI performance, evaluations, model behavior, observability, reliability, and cost to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Threat modeling AI systems and ensuring appropriate protections exist around data access, agent actions, tool execution, model behavior, and other AI-specific risks.
* Mentoring engineers through architecture discussions, design reviews, code reviews, and complex technical challenges.
* Advising security and executive leadership on AI strategy, technical trade-offs, emerging risks, and the practical implications of changes in AI technology.

**This job might be for you if:**

* You’re a technical leader who still builds – you enjoy setting architecture and direction, but you still want to write production code and personally tackle the problems where your involvement creates the greatest leverage.
* You think beyond individual applications – you naturally look for the shared platforms, patterns, services, and standards that allow many teams to build better and faster.
* You’re practical about AI – you can separate meaningful technological change from hype and focus teams on where AI can produce measurable security outcomes.
* You’re comfortable making hard technical decisions – you can evaluate competing technologies and approaches, make a recommendation, explain the trade-offs, and stand behind the decision.
* You’re security-minded by design – you treat AI as both a defensive capability and an attack surface and consider adversarial behavior from the beginning.
* You’re a multiplier – you want the engineers and teams around you to become stronger because of the architecture, standards, mentorship, and technical guidance you provide.
* You lead through influence – you can establish technical direction and build alignment across teams and stakeholders even when they don’t report to you.

You own our data-architecture standards, including how datastores are introduced and retired.

You set our identity and security standards and own security reviews with the Security team
* Architecture and design. You design systems that span many services and teams, and you write architecture decision records that make the trade-offs explicit. You own our technical roadmap and style guide, act as the arbiter on standards, and decide on evidence rather than authority. You are able to trace many symptoms back to a single root cause and fix it once.
* Engineering practices. You work trunk-based with GitHub Flow, small changes and feature flags, and you know CI/CD pipelines inside out. You have led deprecations and migrations all the way to switching the old system off. You set our Git, CI/CD and dependency policies, and you make large-scale change routine rather than exceptional.

You understand complex problems quickly, ask the right questions and confirm shared understanding before acting. You collaborate well across locations and cultures, working asynchronously and handing over cleanly between time zones. You are proactive: you spot problems and opportunities before you are asked, propose solutions and innovations of your own, and drive them through without waiting for instructions.

You define the hiring bar for each level, calibrate interviewers and give Talent Acquisition clear screening criteria.   : Investigate and resolve complex technical incidents in the SAP landscape. Perform root cause analysis on recurring issues and implement preventive measures to reduce future occurrences.

  : Produce and maintain accurate technical documentation including functional specifications, technical design documents, unit test scripts, and change logs to support audits and knowledge transfer.

  : Ensure all ABAP developments are thoroughly unit tested and participate in quality assurance activities including SIT and UAT support to deliver reliable, defect-free software.

  : Engage proactively with functional leads across SD, MM, and FI domains to understand business requirements, provide technical feasibility input, and ensure delivered solutions align with process and compliance needs.

* Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field; 3 -5 years of hands-on SAP ABAP development experience; SAP certification is an advantage.

* **On-Time Delivery**
  : Percentage of development tasks and project deliverables completed within agreed timelines and within estimated effort.
* **Code Quality**
  : Reduction in post-go-live defects attributable to development activities; adherence to coding standards as measured through reviews.
* **Incident & Change Response**

* **Stakeholder Satisfaction**
  : Positive feedback from functional leads on technical delivery, communication quality, and responsiveness.

Pentland Brands is the name behind some of the world’s best-known sport, outdoor and lifestyle brands, including Speedo, Berghaus, Canterbury, Endura, Ellesse, Kickers and Mitre.

Joining Pentland Brands means becoming part of a business where your work can have real reach, across multiple brands, markets, teams and disciplines. It is a place for people who want to contribute, collaborate, improve how things are done and help build the future of brands with heritage, ambition and global impact.

**Perks & Benefits**

Alongside a competitive salary and discretionary bonus, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your wellbeing, flexibility, and life outside work. This includes generous holiday allowance, hybrid and flexible working, employee transportation, pension and gratuity contributions, wellbeing support, medical, personal accident & term life insurance cover.

**The Interview Process**

We want our interview process to feel clear, straightforward, and supportive. If your experience and expectations look like a strong match for the role, here’s what you can expect next:

1. **Talent Team Intro Call**

2. **Experience Interview**

3. **Final Interview**
